description: The bar chart illustrates dataset statistics by displaying the sample count for different writing genres across two dataset types. The horizontal axis contains the categories, which are ordered from left to right as Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository, without an explicit axis label. The vertical axis represents the value and is labeled "Sample Count," utilizing a linear scale with numeric tick marks ranging from 0 to 120 at regular intervals of 20. The chart features grouped vertical bars, where each category contains two adjacent bars. According to the legend in the top right corner, the light blue bars on the left of each group represent "Open" (Open-Ended sets) and the light pink bars on the right represent "Cons." (Constrained sets). Each bar is visually emphasized with an annotation of its exact numerical value at the top. For the Argumentative category, the Open bar is 79 and the Cons. bar is 122. In the Narrative category, the Open bar is 80 and the Cons. bar is 87. For the Descriptive category, the Open bar is 68 and the Cons. bar is 100. In the Expository category, the Open bar is 62, which is the shortest bar in the chart, while the Cons. bar is 130, representing the tallest bar. The categories are not sorted in a specific alphabetical or numerical order.
